◆ Lb25State

enum Lb25State

LB25 state for numeric expression context tracking.

Used for Example 7 regex-based tailoring from UAX #14-49.

Enumerator
LB25_NONE 

Not in numeric expression.

LB25_PREFIX 

Seen PR or PO (prefix).

LB25_PREFIXOP 

Saw (PR|PO) then OP or HY.

LB25_NUM 

Inside NU (NU|SY|IS)*.

LB25_NUMCLOSE 

Saw NU (NU|SY|IS)* (CL|CP).

◆ PendingRule

enum PendingRule

Identifies which lookahead rule currently has a tentative break pending resolution by the next character.

Enumerator
PENDING_NONE 

No pending tentative break.

PENDING_LB15B 

LB15b: tentative break before a Pf&QU.

PENDING_LB15C 

LB15c: tentative break before IS after SP.

PENDING_LB19A 

LB19a: tentative break before a Pi&QU.

PENDING_LB28A4 

LB28a sub-rule 4: tentative break after aksara.
